I am writing to apply for the Founding Engineer position at Wexford Health. With six years of backend engineering experience, including building and owning a high-throughput order-routing service, I bring hands-on expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

As an engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I led a team of five across dispatch and billing, and previously spearheaded a nine-month migration from a monolith to event-driven services, cutting p99 checkout latency from 1.9s to 340ms with zero customer-visible downtime.

I work comfortably across the stack, including Kubernetes and Terraform for deployment, and have deep PostgreSQL skills from schema design to logical replication. I am eager to apply that breadth to a founding role at Wexford Health.
